Warning signs are guaranteed high return: Alamomin faɗakarwa suna da tabbacin samun babban riba, matsa lamba don yin aiki da sauri, lada don ɗaukar ma'aikata, biyan kuɗi a cikin asusun sirri, kuma babu rajista tare da SEC Nigeria.
Loan apps: on the FCCPC approved list?: Aikace-aikacen lamuni: akan jerin da aka amince da FCCPC?
Investments: registered with SEC Nigeria: Zuba jari: rijista da SEC Nigeria?
Banks: licensed by the CBN?: Bankuna: CBN ya ba da lasisi?
App wants all your contacts? Warning sig: App yana son duk abokan hulɗar ku? Alamar faɗakarwa
Sent money to a fraudster? Call your ban: Aiko kudi ga mai zamba? Kira bankin ku yanzu
Check loan apps on the FCCPC list, inves: Duba aikace-aikacen lamuni akan jerin FCCPC, dandamalin saka hannun jari tare da SEC Nigeria, da bankuna tare da CBN. Ka'idar da ke son duk lambobinku da hotuna alamar gargaɗi ce.
If you have sent money to a fraudster, c: Idan kun aika kuɗi ga mai zamba, tuntuɓi bankin ku nan da nan ta hanyoyinsa na hukuma kuma ku kai rahoto ga 'yan sanda. Kuma idan yin fare yana ɗaukar nauyi a cikin gidan ku, share aikace-aikacen, gaya wa amintaccen mutum, kuma nemi tallafi.
Hauwa's goal: 180,000 naira in 9 months: Burin Hauwa: Naira 180,000 a cikin wata 9
Specific: second pot, cooler and packagi: Specific: tukunya na biyu, mai sanyaya da marufi
Into a locked target savings plan: A cikin tsarin tanadin manufa da aka kulle
Balance on a wall chart each month: Daidaita akan jadawalin bango kowane wata
Goals give your saving a direction. A SM: Maƙasudai suna ba da jagorar ajiyar ku. Manufar SMART takamaimai ce, mai aunawa, mai yuwuwa, mai dacewa da ƙayyadaddun lokaci.
For example, Hauwa makes kunu and zobo i: Misali, Hauwa tana yin kunu da zobo a Zariya. Za ta tanadi kimanin naira 180,000 a tukunyar girki na biyu, da injin sanyaya kirji da marufi kafin ranar 30 ga watan Yuni.
180,000 divided by 9 months is about 20,: 180,000 da aka raba ta watanni 9 shine kusan 20,000 a wata, ko kusan 5,000 a mako.
Every Friday she saves 5,000 into a lock: Kowace Juma'a tana adana 5,000 a cikin tsarin kulle kafin ta dawo, kuma tana yin rikodin ma'auni akan taswirar bango. Gina asusun gaggawa na farko, sannan ku ci gaba zuwa maƙasudai masu ban sha'awa kamar wannan.
For example, Ifeoma gives her 8-year-old: Misali, Ifeoma tana baiwa danta Chidi dan shekara 8 kimanin naira 1,000 a mako domin ayyukan yi.
Children learn money habits mostly by wa: Yara suna koyon halayen kuɗi galibi ta hanyar kallon manya. Misali, Ifeoma tana baiwa danta Chidi kimanin naira 1,000 a mako domin yin shara da wanke-wanke.
They agree on three jars: 500 naira to S: Sun yarda akan tulu guda uku: Naira 500 don Ajiye, 300 don kashewa, 200 don rabawa.
Chidi wants a football costing about 5,0: Chidi yana son wasan kwallon kafa na kimanin naira 5,000. Da 500 a mako, yana zuwa can a cikin makonni 10, kuma ya saya da kudinsa.
Teach older children never to share PINs: Koyar da manyan yara kar su taɓa raba PIN ko OTPs, kuma kada su danna hanyoyin haɗin yanar gizo masu yin alkawarin kuɗi kyauta.
Change one money habit for 30 days: Canza al'adar kuɗi ɗaya na kwanaki 30
Now change one money habit, do your debt: Yanzu canza al'adar kuɗi ɗaya, bincika bashin ku da zamba, rubuta shirin burin ku, kuma fara al'adar kuɗi tare da yaro. Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
